description:
The Productivity Apps team is looking for a passionate engineer to help shape the text experiences at the heart of Pages, Numbers, and Keynote. We build the text engine, editing surfaces, and input systems that millions of people use every day. If you enjoy typography, native app development, and collaborating with a strong team, this role is a great fit.

Description
You will own and evolve core text rendering and editing features in iOS and macOS productivity applications. Day to day, you will write production Swift and Objective-C, collaborate closely with design and platform teams, and ship polished, high-quality releases on a regular cadence.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain text engine components for iOS and macOS productivity applications
Build rich editing features using CoreText APIs with an eye toward performance and correctness
Implement UI to unlock new typographical features and workflows
Debug complex layout, input, and rendering issues across Apple platforms
Collaborate with design, QA, and platform engineers to define and refine features
Write thorough unit and integration tests to maintain high code quality
Review code from peers and provide constructive, technically grounded feedback

Minimum qualifications
3+ years of professional iOS or macOS software engineering experience
Strong foundation in UIKit or AppKit
Proficiency in Swift or Objective-C
Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex bugs
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Preferred qualifications
Hands-on experience with TextKit or Core Text
Familiarity with macOS and iOS text input systems
Experience using AI coding tools
Experience contributing to or maintaining a shared codebase across multiple Apple platforms
Comfortable working in large, complex codebases
